input.prompt: An authentic Srikalahasti kalamkari hand-painted cotton roundel, photographed flat and straight-on. Match the attached reference cloth exactly in palette, kalam line quality, dotted and cross-hatched fill patterns, cotton weave texture and lotus motifs. Composition: one single large circular medallion centred on a plain flat square of undyed ecru cotton; the medallion fills about 88 percent of the frame width, with only a thin margin of plain ecru cloth around it. The medallion's outer ring is a border of pointed lotus petals drawn in kalam outline with dotted madder-red fills, between two thin rings of dotted pattern. Inside the ring the ground is dyed deep indigo blue. At the exact centre sits one open lotus flower in ecru with red dot fills and green leaves. Arranged evenly around the central lotus, each object clearly separated and drawn large enough to read: (1) an open ledger book lying flat, its two ecru pages covered only with plain evenly spaced horizontal ruled lines and one vertical margin line, completely blank otherwise, its cover edged in madder red with a dotted border pattern; (2) a classic fountain pen with a pointed split nib, its barrel decorated with a dotted turmeric-yellow pattern, lying diagonally; (3) a rising stock-market bar chart: a row of six upright flat-topped rectangular bars standing side by side, short on the left and taller step by step to the right like a staircase, alternately madder red and leaf green, each bar filled with dense hand-drawn kalam patterns (dots, cross-hatching, scales) and drawn as the thick straight stem of a lotus plant; the bar tops are flat and plain with nothing on them; only from the top of the tallest bar on the far right grows a single closed pointed lotus bud aiming straight upward like an arrow. Small lotus buds, paisley leaves and dotted vine tendrils fill the gaps between the objects. Style: freehand kalam (bamboo pen) outlines in iron-black with confident, slightly irregular line weight; flat natural vegetable-dye fills only: deep madder red, indigo blue, myrobalan-turmeric yellow, green made from indigo over yellow, and undyed ecru cotton; dense hand-drawn fill patterns of dots, cross-hatching, scales and tiny petals; visible hand-woven cotton weave and slight dye bleed. Completely flat, no perspective, no shading, no gradients, no metallic gold, no 3D, no photorealism. No people, no hands, no faces. The ledger pages carry only ruled lines: absolutely no text, no letters, no writing, no numbers, no digits, no currency symbols, no scribbles anywhere in the image. No lamps, no diyas, no candles, no wicks, no fire, no flames, nothing burning on top of the bars.
